name: tax-line
why: The tax line on an estimate is a statement to a tax authority as well as to the customer. A wrong figure is not a bug report, it is a filing problem, and it is not ours to get wrong quietly.

guardrails.name: tax-response-shape
guardrails.asserts: Every response from the tax service is shape-checked before its figure is used, so a vendor-side change surfaces here instead of on an estimate.

externalBoundary.describes: The figure is computed by a separate tax service and this repo only forwards it. No local check can verify the value; a change here can only be shown not to alter the request we send or the response we accept.
externalBoundary.compensating: A contract test runs against the tax service's sandbox on a schedule, outside this repo's CI. If that test has not passed in 7 days, treat this field as unverified.
